feeds.note: GBIF publishes iNaturalist and survey datasets in weekly batches; records arrive days to weeks after the observation
USGS NAS curates lionfish records weeks to months after the observation; newest Florida record 2026-09-10 (curated 18 days later), Mexico 2026-02-13, Belize 2026-02-24, Colombia 2016-02-23
daily 5 km product, about 1.7 days behind real time by design; within its 2-day cadence
hourly modelled wave and current forecast, 72 h horizon; model run fetched hourly
sea-temperature buoys exist only in the Florida Keys area
